item.description:

  • ブランド: Calcite
  • 発売日: 2022-04-28
  • スコア: 5.96/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 気になるあの娘はえろちゅーばー!
  • 英語名: Ki ni Naru Ano Ko wa Erotuber!

あらすじ

The main character “Nishi Eita”, with his sharp intuition and passion for streamers, discovers that his classmate “Yume Harukawa” is a famous singer-streamer. While trying to use the secret to get closer, Eita also meets other streamers through Yume.

Ritsu Shinonome is a friend of Yume and a V-streamer. Yuuka Asaki is the wife of a neighbor and live-streamer of retro games.

“I will do whatever you say if you start your job hunting.”

The girls found my proposal interesting and accepted the conditions.

The reward they requested is… a date with me!?

The protagonist, Yutaro Miki is a rookie NEET rehabilitation officer.

A NEET rehabilitation officer is a staff member of a publicly funded, privately operated organization dedicated to the “rehabilitation of NEETs”.

item.title: Isekai de Ore wa Ero Keiei no Top ni Naru!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Calcite
  • 発売日: 2020-03-27
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 異世界で俺はエロ経営のトップになる!
  • 英語名: Isekai de Ore wa Ero Keiei no Top ni Naru!

あらすじ

After dying in an accident in modern-day Japan, the protagonist is reincarnated as Kurt Lamelz, the youngest son of a noble family in another world.

Dreaming of becoming the strongest in this new world, he’s devastated when the skill granted to him by the gods upon adulthood turns out to be “Prank Magic”—a seemingly useless ability.
